label: Tier 1: parameters
subgoals: Map widths, depths, stage counts and port counts to parameters
Re-run the generator and its parameterized golden tests

label: Tier 2: a new policy at a seam
section: Tier 2: a new policy at a seam
subgoals: Define the seam as the narrow interface the policy implements
Implement only the new policy behind it
Prove the new policy equivalent to the existing ones

label: Tier 3: the core
subgoals: Identify changes to emitted clocks, resets, naming or semantics as core
Require a human-approved diff and full regression
Judge the tier by the reach of the change, not its size
